sources.excerpt: Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FETTO Nord 70+ Home News Amps Pedals Custom Shop Download About Contact Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FETTO Nord 70+: Original Handcrafted Overdrive Next Owner’s Manual Review… FETTO History GREAT OL’ DISTORTION + BOOST  Handcrafted with care, the FETTO Nord 70+ is an all-analog, original design. Evolving from the original “ FETTO 9.0 ” model since 2004, this pedal is made to amplify your amp’s natural sound while giving you versatile tone options. Every unit is built individually, ensuring high-quality craftsmanship and dynamic performance with no replicas. GREAT OL’ DISTORTION + BOOST  FETTO Nord 70+ is an extension of the original “ FETTO 9.0 ” (2004) and also an extraction of  FETTO Nord+  as the great  Mikael Nord Andersson  loved it and developed it with us in 2008-2009. Note: If you want a great sounding but more simple/smaller version of FETTO Nord 70+ (=no external switches and no boost) check out  FETTO Jr. 70! Excellent string separation/definition all the way from smooth overdrive into heavy’ish 70’ish distortion. The character of your instrument and amplifier will not get lost – but gained! And this one is designed to match the volume control on your guitar perfectly. Most pedals on Earth sounds just like pedals. Not the case with FETTO Nord 70+ , this swivel-hipped loudmouth, born and living in another dimension? – Ed  &  Mick  &  Lizzy  here we go! IN / OUT Input Input impedance : approx. 1 MΩ Output Output impedance : approx. 10 kΩ Push Switches DRIVE Mechanical true-bypass switching for the OVERDRIVE circuit (ON = Blue LED). BOOST Mechanical true-bypass switching for the BOOST circuit (ON = Orange LED). * DRIVE / BOOST order changeable via internal jumpers. Power DC Input 9–18 V DC , very low current draw. Optional AC adapter: 9–18 V DC, center-pin negative (BOSS-standard, regulated). Potentiometers Drive Natural amp-like overdrive from light → medium → heavier textures (never Metal). FETTO “70” voicing leans toward a classic Marshall Plexi-style character. Volume OVERDRIVE output level. Boost BOOST output level. Treble Passive high-frequency tone control. Internals * PRES. : 3-position toggle – higher-frequency character (passive). GAIN : 2-position toggle – HIGH / LOW gain level. DRIVE GAIN, DRIVE BASS and BOOST GAIN trimmers. 3 × jumpers for DRIVE / BOOST order. * May vary slightly depending on production day, version and serial number. Dimensions & Weight Size 111.6 × 61.6 × 50.0 mm (L/W/H) — 4.37 × 2.4 × 1.9 in. Weight Approx. 310 g (0.7 lbs) Colour / Finish May vary depending on season and sometimes for a reason. From Feb 2010 onward: Stockholm White (RAL 9010) with grey / silver print. Delivered with FETTO Nord 70+ ► 70’s sound and feel you have not experienced before ► 1 x 9 volts battery (6LR61) ► 1 x printed Owner’s Manual ► 1 x Warranty: The Himmelstrutz Elektro Art products includes a 1 year limited materials- and factory warranty (from delivery date). The warranty does not include batteries and consumables. Product service is free of charge during the warranty time. The warranty does not include errors due to product modifications, internal adjustments, disassembly, negligence / violence, incorrect power supply usage/incorrect connections or thunder. Shipping costs in non warranty cases is on the product owner FETTO Nord 70+ Audiovisual blocks inside product pages.--> Buy FETTO Nord 70+ USD $399 plus shipping Buy Now – USD EUR €399 plus shipping Buy Now – EUR Owner’s Manual Next ORDERING PAYMENT SHIPPING At Himmelstrutz Elektro Art each product and unit is handcrafted with the mission to release the best possible sound, feel and looks. Himmelstrutz is a Swedish company making amps and pedals. It has a drive switch and a boost switch that works independently or in combination. It has a low gain/hi gain switch, volume out and threeway presence switch plus a treble knob. Drive and boost has separate volume knobs. This is what they say on their web site: "Excellent string separation/definition all the way from smooth overdrive into heavy’ish 70’ish distortion.
